note.after_visit_summary: Your child has an ear infection in the left ear and a cold. We prescribed amoxicillin 9 mL by mouth twice daily for 10 days to treat the infection. For pain or fever, you may give ibuprofen 8 mL by mouth every 6 to 8 hours as needed, or acetaminophen 7.5 mL by mouth every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Make sure to finish all the amoxicillin even if she feels better. She can return to daycare after being fever-free for 24 hours without medicine. Call us if fever or ear pain lasts more than 48 to 72 hours after starting antibiotics, or if you see swelling or redness behind the ear, or if she is hard to wake up. No routine follow-up is needed if she improves quickly, but return if she gets another ear infection in the next few months.
